Frequently Asked Questions

Your trust is our top priority. Here you'll find answers to frequently asked questions, so you know exactly what to expect.

How exactly do I use this?

Simply roll it behind your ears, and optionally on your temples. It absorbs quickly and isn’t greasy.

Is it safe to use every day?

Yes, it contains only natural essential oils with no harmful additives. You can safely apply it several times a day.

When will I notice results?

Most users feel relief within 5 minutes. For lasting calm, you can continue daily use.

What makes this different from medicines or other products?

Medicines often cause drowsiness or side effects. This works immediately, without making you sleepy, and targets the balance system directly.

Who is this suitable for?

It’s ideal for anyone struggling with tinnitus, ear ringing, or dizziness. Both younger and older users report fast relief.

Can I buy it for family and friends if they want to try it too?

Yes! With our “the more you buy, the more you save” program, it’s a good idea to buy multiple sets and save even more!
